purpose: Activation-time proof reconciling exact accepted T10/T11 public identifiers against the exact post-T11 integration lineage. Resolution is read-only evidence for T12 fact-slot binding.

resolved_public_id_shape.kind: semantic kind such as transform_state, transform_recipe, camp_state, camp_recipe_binding
resolved_public_id_shape.source_path: repository-relative JSON source containing the identifier
resolved_public_id_shape.json_pointer: RFC6901-style pointer resolving to the exact identifier value

rules: Every resolved ID is proven by an ownership-safe repository source_path plus exact JSON pointer, byte-identical to the accepted dependency commit.
No provisional/prepared/example/debug/test-only identifier is promoted as a shipping progression binding.
Resolution is read-only proof. T12 may consume accepted IDs but may not mutate T10/T11 source files or semantics.
Any missing or ambiguous required ID blocks T12 activation rather than being guessed.
Every resolved public ID kind is allowed for its owning task, and any T10/T11 shipping binding must use an ID kind compatible with the binding fact_kind.
